messages.author: 2ce077c94446e7f1
messages.subject: additive and dominance effects and %variance
parts:
Hi Karl,
Is it "sound" to calculate additive and dominance effects and % variance with non- normal data? The command I have been using is below and requires me to use either a normal or binary model.

out.fqtl <- fitqtl(swarm, qtl=qtl, covar=NULL, formula=y~Q1+Q2, model="normal", dropone=TRUE, get.ests=TRUE,
run.checks=TRUE, tol=1e-4, maxit=1000, forceXcovar=FALSE)

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] additive and dominance effects and %variance
parts:
The issue is identical to that of linear regression, with the effects being regression coefficients and percent variance being like r^2.

karl
